name: G4 stochastic ambient scheduler refinement
invariants: Lively current cadence is the selected default direction
travelling currents are distributed across the full visible world rather than repeating at fixed authored positions
current lanes snap to the 20px grid
current orientation, start, direction, distance, segment length and timing vary
major-grid glints occur only on 100px intersections
glints use an independent quiet scheduler and do not accelerate with Lively current cadence
at most two glints are concurrent
ambient drift varies in start position, size, vector and opacity
localized semantic activity remains separate from decorative ambient motion
reduced motion disables decorative ambient animation
allowed_adaptations: ambient counts may scale with world dimensions while preserving salience hierarchy
scheduler and visual classes may be namespaced or componentized during integration
logical world dimensions rather than transformed screen bounds may drive grid-coherent spawning
fixture_caveats: Quiet/Balanced/Lively controls are design-lab comparison controls; Lively is the human-preferred integrated cadence
fixture semantic-activity positions are not a frozen project-layout decision
verification: exact historical blob verification for all three combined-dynamics source files
current-branch blob equality against the exact historical refinement
reason_for_supplement: The original M02 manifest entry preserved the correct Research 042-043 invariants but bound only the later SEL2-compatible WorkUnit grammar snapshot. Human integrated review exposed that the actual stochastic scheduler source was omitted from the machine-readable implementation graph. This supplement makes the later accepted scheduler an explicit required M02 source without weakening the existing SEL2-compatible substrate binding.
